Kaplan (Quartz Data): Hey team, we've got a surprise spike for APAC demos starting in ~30m, hitting 2.5x normal qps. We're seeing 429s and long tails. Can we get a temporary regional egress leeway and higher per-minute token window?
Amanda - CS: Thanks Kaplan — can you share the source IP ranges or CIDR? Also expected sustained qps and peak duration?
Kaplan (Quartz Data): We'll originate from 52.88.120.0/22 and 13.250.0.0/16. Expect ~350 rps steady with 1k rps peaks for 45 minutes. Demo ends by 22:15 SGT.
Ingrid (NetEng): Noted. For dedicated vs hosted: are you on Hosted API? I see your account on Hosted tier with burst protections. We can apply a temporary regional exception and bump the per-customer QPM. Need org-id and desired rollback time.
Mia (CS Ops): Kaplan, can you paste the org id? I'll open the provisioning ticket and tag infra.
Kaplan (Quartz Data): org-qa-9072. Rollback please at 22:50 SGT. Also flagging that some responses have lower confidence scores, may want fallback model routing if overloaded.
Amanda - CS: Got it — filing ticket now. Ingrid, suggested uplift: increase QPS ceiling to 1.2k per second for APAC region and add CIDR 52.88.120.0/22 to allowlist; set temp TTL 45m + 15m buffer.
Ingrid (NetEng): Working on it. Applying allowlist and creating a scoped rate window: "policy: regional-temp-uplift", target regions [ap-southeast-1], qps:1200, expiry:2026-03-21T14:50:00+08:00. Will update when applied.
deploy-bot: policy regional-temp-uplift applied to org-qa-9072 for ap-southeast-1. Changes: allowlist 52.88.120.0/22, qps 1200, expiry 2026-03-21T14:50:00+08:00. :white_check_mark:
Mia (CS Ops): Kaplan — monitoring dashboards are green so far. Please report any downstream errors. We'll auto-revoke at expiry unless you request extension.
Kaplan (Quartz Data): Thanks team :rocket: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Amanda - CS: captured notes for renewal playbook: customer had demo-led spike; suggestion: enable baseline uplift option in onboarding for demo windows.
Ingrid (NetEng): Logging ticket with postmortem checklist — if we see repeated demo spikes we'll propose a reserved dedicated pool for predictable latency.
